description: Frozen golden manifest for the cumulative Phase-4 catalog (guanlan_v2.orchestration.trial.phase4_catalog_snapshot). base_catalog_digest MUST equal the immutable Phase-3 FULL (data + memory) catalog digest (the sole legal base); catalog_digest seals the cumulative Phase-4 catalog.
